info.title: LMS AI Interview Service
info.description: AI-conducted interviews for practice and hiring: plans with fixed core questions and a weighted rubric, a director that decides what is asked next (the model only proposes follow-ups), speech and a live compiler through other services, evidence-checked scoring with a recommendation the model never chooses, mandatory human review for hiring, appeals decided by a second person, and calibration and fairness audits.

post.description: A screening plan (recruiters and admins, for the company's own jobs) or a mock-interview plan (platform careers managers). Rounds carry the core questions asked to every candidate verbatim; the AI only adds follow-ups.

AnswerText.title: AnswerText
AnswerText.description: A typed turn (an audio one is posted as multipart form data instead).

CalibrationTurnIn.title: CalibrationTurnIn
CalibrationTurnIn.description: The same shape a transcript's turns come in (``TurnOut``): copy them from a past interview to build a sample.

CurrentRoundOut.title: CurrentRoundOut
CurrentRoundOut.description: The round the interview is in: what the candidate's screen needs (a coding round shows the editor with these languages).

note.title: Note
note.description: Required when the appeal is denied: the candidate reads it

message.title: Message
examples: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. +919876543210

message.title: Message
examples: Some fields are missing or invalid.

total_is_exact.title: Total Is Exact
total_is_exact.description: False when more records match than were counted

criteria_weights.title: Criteria Weights
criteria_weights.description: Defaults to equal weight across the criteria the rounds use

ReportOut.title: ReportOut
ReportOut.description: The candidate's own report. The recommendation is never shown here — only the recruiter and careers managers see it (docs/PRODUCT.md §5.8).

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: Send none to confirm the AI's recommendation, or one of strong_yes/yes/lean_no/no to override it

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Defaults to the round type's usual criteria

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: The model could not produce a follow-up: the director moved on to the next core question

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Base64, only when asked for and speech is configured

TurnPair.title: TurnPair
TurnPair.description: One exchange: the turn just recorded and (unless the interview ended first) the interviewer's reply.
